security_principle: Infrastructure transparency is acceptable. Infrastructure accessibility is not.

services.name: Ace Help Desk
services.purpose: User-facing support, classroom guided learning, ticket workflows, and knowledge management.
services.privilege_boundary: Anonymous low-risk submission may be allowed with validation, rate limiting, logging, and tightly scoped backend permissions. Ticket administration requires the backend system's own authentication.

services.name: Knowledge Base
services.purpose: Validated operational procedures and classroom knowledge rendered in a readable portal view.
services.public_visibility: Public-safe articles may be browsed anonymously.
services.privilege_boundary: Contribution and approval continue through GitHub identity and repository permissions rather than ProfessorSneaker accounts.

services.name: GLPI
services.purpose: Target service-management system of record for tickets, requests, assignments, incidents, and operational workflow.
services.public_visibility: ProfessorSneaker may disclose that GLPI exists and may present sanitized service information.
services.privilege_boundary: GLPI itself is not made publicly accessible merely because ProfessorSneaker references it. Privileged actions authenticate at GLPI or through a narrowly scoped integration.

services.name: DHCP & DNS
services.system_of_record: GitHub today / infrastructure source of truth future
services.purpose: Foundational network services for production SOTE.
services.public_visibility: The portal may disclose their role and deployment status.
services.privilege_boundary: No public management interface or administrative pathway is exposed through ProfessorSneaker.

services.name: NetBox
services.purpose: Planned infrastructure source of truth for racks, devices, interfaces, cabling, addressing, VLANs, and topology.
services.public_visibility: ProfessorSneaker may render sanitized infrastructure facts sourced from NetBox.
services.privilege_boundary: NetBox authentication and permissions remain separate. Public portal integration must use read-only, minimum-scope access and must not expose sensitive topology or management detail.

services.name: Secret Storage System
services.purpose: Centralized role-appropriate credential and secret storage for SOTE infrastructure and services.
services.public_visibility: The portal may disclose that the capability exists and point authorized operators to documented procedures.
services.privilege_boundary: ProfessorSneaker must never contain, cache, render, proxy, or expose secrets. Authentication occurs at the secret-storage system through approved identity and access controls.
